tagline: Room to stretch out flat, on a waterproof outer that wipes clean.
lead: After a proper walk your dog can lie out flat, and everyday marks wipe off the waterproof outer.
value: The waterproof layer is the green outer fabric itself, not a liner hidden inside, so a wet coat meets it first.
intro: Fern is an open dog mattress with no raised sides, a waterproof green outer fabric, a filled support layer, zip-off covers, leather handles and a non-slip base. Medium and Large.
points: No walls around the edge, so they can lie out flat.
The green outer fabric is the waterproof surface, not just an inner liner.
A filled support layer cushions the sleeping surface.
Leather handles to move it between their favourite spots, and a non-slip base underneath.
best_for: Dogs who sprawl after a walk, and owners who want the waterproof layer on the outside rather than hidden inside.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying down, nose to base of tail, and allow 15–20cm extra. With no sides, the whole surface is theirs to lie on. Between sizes? Ask us before ordering.
care: Wipe the outer fabric for everyday marks. Check the sewn-in label before washing a removable cover, as detergent and machine washing can affect some waterproof finishes. The leather handles have their own care instructions.
seo_title: Waterproof Dog Mattress with Leather Handles | Snoozly
seo_description: A waterproof dog mattress with no sides, so your dog can stretch right out. Green wipe-clean outer, leather handles, non-slip base. Medium and Large.
